sentences.en: Management tried to appease labor by offering them a bonus.
sentences.zh: 管理层试图通过提供奖金来安抚工人。

sentences.en: Avoid heavy labor It will be better in two weeks.
sentences.zh: 避免重体力劳动。两周后会好一些。

sentences.en: They worked out the system with much thought and labor.
sentences.zh: 他们经过深思熟虑和辛勤工作才制定出这个系统。

senses.zh: 苦干，劳动，分娩，阵痛，致力于
